https://www.eatingwell.com/creamy-zucchi.Description: Spaghetti is coated in a silky, garlic-infused cream sauce that clings to every bite, while fresh zucchini slices add a touch of sweetness and a pop of color.
Ingredients: ¼ cup plain dry whole-wheat breadcrumbs
1 small yellow onion, finely chopped (about 1 cup)
1 medium zucchini, thinly sliced into half-moons (about 2 cups)
Instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil over high heat. Add 8 ounces spaghetti; cook according to package directions for al dente, stirring occasionally, about 7 minutes. Reserve ½ cup of the cooking water; drain the pasta.

Meanwhile, heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add ¼ cup breadcrumbs and ½ teaspoon Italian seasoning; cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl; stir in 2 teaspoons lemon zest; set aside. Wipe the skillet clean.

Add chopped onion and the remaining 2 teaspoons oil to the skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring often, until translucent, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in sliced zucchini, ½ teaspoon salt, ¼ teaspoon pepper and the remaining 1½ teaspoons Italian seasoning. Spread the zucchini mixture in an even layer. Cook, undisturbed, until lightly browned in spots, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown all over, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat.

When the pasta is done, return the zucchini mixture to medium heat. Stir in the cooked pasta, reserved cooking water, ¾ cup cream, 6 tablespoons Parmesan and 2 tablespoons lemon juice. Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce is creamy and coats the pasta, about 5 minutes. Divide among 4 bowls; top with the breadcrumb mixture. Garnish with basil, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/lemony-orzo-t.Title: Lemony Orzo & Tuna Salad with Broccoli
https://www.eatingwell.com/lemony-orzo-t.Description: This pasta- and tuna-salad mashup gets a boost of color and texture from broccoli. Plenty of Kalamata olives add a briny bite.
Ingredients: 2 (5-ounce) cans tuna in olive oil, drained and flaked
Instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Add 2 cups orzo; cook, stirring occasionally, until just al dente, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Meanwhile, whisk lemon zest, lemon juice, ¼ cup oil, ½ teaspoon pepper and ¼ teaspoon salt in a large bowl.
Add the orzo, 4 cups broccoli, the flaked tuna, 1 cup olives and 1 tablespoon oregano to the dressing; stir to combine.

https://www.eatingwell.com/herb-marinate.Title: Herb-Marinated Veggie & Chickpea Salad
https://www.eatingwell.com/herb-marinate.Description: This herb-marinated veggie & chickpea salad is a refreshing, no-cook dish packed with fresh flavors.
Ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley, plus more for garnish
1 medium red bell pepper, stems and seeds removed, roughly chopped
1 (14.5 ounce) can no-salt added chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1/2 head romaine lettuce, roughly chopped (about 5 cups)
Instructions: Whisk 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon mustard, ¼ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon pepper together in a large bowl until smooth. Add ¼ cup parsley and 2 teaspoons thyme; whisk to combine. Slowly drizzle in ¼ cup oil while continuing to whisk until well combined. Add chopped tomato, chopped bell pepper, ¼ cup onion and the rinsed chickpeas; toss well. Let marinate at room temperature for at least 15 minutes and up to 1 hour.
When ready to serve, add 5 cups lettuce and 2 cups cabbage to the bowl; toss well to combine. Divide the salad among 4 bowls; top with ⅓ cup Parmesan. Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/chocolate-str.Title: Chocolate-Strawberry Protein Shake
https://www.eatingwell.com/chocolate-str.Description: Soy milk and Greek-style yogurt provide a solid protein base for this chocolate-strawberry protein shake.
Ingredients: ½ cup low-fat plain strained (Greek-style) yogurt
Instructions: Place ¾ cup soy milk, ⅓ cup banana, 1 cup strawberries, ½ cup yogurt, ½ tablespoon cocoa powder and 2 ice cubes in a blender; process until smooth.

https://www.eatingwell.com/watermelon-pe.Title: Watermelon-Peach Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/watermelon-pe.Description: This watermelon-peach smoothie is a refreshing drink that's perfect for warm days.
Instructions: Combine 2 cups watermelon, 2 cups peaches and 1¼ cups yogurt in a blender. Blend until smooth.

https://www.eatingwell.com/shredded-whea.Title: Shredded Wheat with Raisins & Walnuts
https://www.eatingwell.com/shredded-whea.Description: This shredded wheat with raisins & walnuts is an easy breakfast to reach for when you want something quick with plenty of fiber and healthy fats.
Ingredients: ½ cup raisins or other unsweetened dried fruit
2 cups reduced-fat milk or other milk of choice, divided
Instructions: Combine 4 cups shredded wheat, 1½ cups walnuts and ½ cup raisins in a large bowl; toss gently to combine. Transfer to a large jar or other resealable food-safe container; store at room temperature for up to 4 months.
To serve, place 1½ cups cereal mixture in a bowl; top with ½ cup milk.

https://www.eatingwell.com/banana-peanut.Title: Banana–Peanut Butter Yogurt Parfait
https://www.eatingwell.com/banana-peanut.Description: This banana–peanut butter yogurt parfait is a delicious and nutritious breakfast or snack that relies on the natural sweetness of ripe bananas to create a creamy, flavorful base.
Ingredients: ¼ cup low-fat plain Greek-style strained yogurt
Instructions: Slice 1 banana; place half the slices in a small bowl or jar. Sprinkle with ⅛ teaspoon cinnamon; mash with the back of a fork. Top with 1 tablespoon peanut butter; layer on ¼ cup yogurt. Top with the remaining banana slices and 1 tablespoon peanuts.

https://www.eatingwell.com/orange-mango-.Title: Dylan Dreyer’s Orange-Mango Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/orange-mango-.Description: For Dylan Dreyer, Today’s 3rd Hour co-host and NBC News meteorologist, this smoothie is a staple in her household during cold and flu season. The vitamin C from the oranges helps support immune health.
Instructions: Combine 2 chopped oranges, ½ cup almond milk, ⅓ cup sliced banana and ⅓ cup mango in a blender. Puree on High until smooth, about 1 minute.

https://www.eatingwell.com/ricotta-toast.Title: Ricotta Toast with Peaches & Prosciutto
https://www.eatingwell.com/ricotta-toast.Description: This ricotta toast with peaches and prosciutto offers the perfect balance of creamy, sweet and savory flavors.
Instructions: Spread ¼ cup ricotta on each of 2 toast slices. Top each with 1 slice prosciutto and half the peach slices. Season to taste with cracked black pepper.

https://www.eatingwell.com/spinach-feta-.Title: Spinach & Feta Mug Scrambled Eggs
https://www.eatingwell.com/spinach-feta-.Description: Whip up eggs with a few simple ingredients in a microwave-safe mug, and you have the makings of a breakfast that’s prepped, seasoned and will be ready to eat in a little more than a minute before running out the door.
Ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill, plus more for garnish
Instructions: Coat 4 (12-ounce) microwave-safe mugs with cooking spray. Crack 2 eggs into each prepared mug. Add 1 tablespoon half-and-half to each; whisk with a fork until completely blended. Add 2 tablespoons spinach, 1 tablespoon feta and 1½ teaspoons dill to each mug, stirring until combined. Sprinkle with salt. Cover and refrigerate for up to 4 days.

When ready to eat, uncover a mug and microwave on High, stirring every 15 to 20 seconds, until set, 1 minute and 15 seconds to 1 minute and 25 seconds for large curds (about 1 minute for soft-scramble). Stir with a fork to create fluffy curds. Sprinkle with additional dill, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/804588.Title: Lemon-Berry Ricotta Toast
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/804588.Description: Creamy ricotta cheese keeps fresh, sweet berries in place in this quick and simple breakfast.
Ingredients: 0.5 teaspoon lemon zest plus 1/4 teaspoon, divided
0.5 cup fresh berries, such as blueberries, strawberries and/or blackberries
Instructions: Mix ricotta, maple syrup and 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest in a small bowl. Spread onto 1 side of each toast slice. Top each toast with 1/4 cup berries and sprinkle with 1/8 teaspoon lemon zest.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/803093.Title: Egg, Spinach & Cheddar Breakfast Sandwich
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/803093.Description: Fill yourself up with this ultra-quick egg, spinach and Cheddar breakfast sandwich.
Instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add spinach, garlic powder, 1/8 teaspoon pepper and salt; cook, stirring, until the spinach is wilted, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

Add the remaining 1 teaspoon oil to the pan. Break egg into the pan; sprinkle with the remaining 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Cook until set on the bottom, 1 to 2 minutes. Break the yolk, then flip the egg and cook, undisturbed, until set, about 1 minute more.
Place the spinach on an English muffin half. Sprinkle with cheese, then top with the fried egg and remaining muffin half.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280738.Title: Spinach, Peanut Butter & Banana Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280738.Description: Peanut butter and banana is a classic combo that's even more delicious with the addition of tangy probiotic-rich kefir. Plus, this peanut butter banana smoothie helps you up your veggie servings for the day with a bit of mild-flavored spinach mixed in.
Instructions: Add kefir, peanut butter, spinach, banana and honey (if using) to a blender. Blend until smooth.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/272746.Title: Mascarpone & Berries Toast
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/272746.Description: Creamy mascarpone is delightful when topped with mixed berries and mint for this bright-tasting, easy and healthy breakfast toast.
Ingredients: 0.25 cup berries, such as raspberries, blueberries and/or chopped strawberries
Instructions: Top toast with mascarpone, berries and mint.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/255160.Title: Peanut Butter & Chia Berry Jam English Muffin
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/255160.Description: The chia seeds in the quick “jam” topping add heart-healthy omega-3s to this healthy breakfast recipe.
Instructions: Microwave berries in a medium microwave-safe bowl for 30 seconds; stir and microwave 30 seconds more. Stir in chia seeds.
Spread peanut butter on the English muffin. Top with the berry-chia mixture.

https://www.eatingwell.com/salsa-topped-.Title: Salsa-Topped Avocado Toast
https://www.eatingwell.com/salsa-topped-.Description: Spin leftovers from taco night into this easy salsa-topped avocado toast for a quick snack, or use it as a jumping-off point for breakfast by adding an egg on top.
Ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh salsa such as pico de gallo
Instructions: Spread avocado on toast. Top with salsa. Season with a pinch of salt.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/794611.Title: Pesto Scrambled Eggs
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/794611.Description: Pep up breakfast with a little pesto. And be careful not to overcook your eggs. Scrambled eggs are at their best when you see soft, creamy curds.
Instructions: Whisk eggs, water and salt in a small bowl. Place pesto in a small nonstick skillet and heat over medium heat. Add the egg mixture and cook, stirring, until the eggs are just set, about 2 minutes. Serve sprinkled with pepper.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/794480.Title: Instant Egg & Cheese "Bake"
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/794480.Description: Learn how to cook eggs in the microwave for a quick, veggie-packed breakfast.
Instructions: Coat an 8-ounce ramekin with cooking spray. Add spinach. Microwave on High until wilted, about 30 seconds. Crack eggs on top, drizzle with milk and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese. Microwave on High until the eggs are set, about 2 minutes. Serve with tortilla.

https://www.eatingwell.com/garlic-butter.Title: The #1 Anti-Inflammatory Dinner You Should Be Making
https://www.eatingwell.com/garlic-butter.Description: Packed with omega-3-rich salmon, antioxidant-loaded beets and cruciferous broccoli, this sheet-pan meal fights inflammation while filling you up.
Ingredients: 2 (8.8-ounce) packages refrigerated cooked beets, quartered (about 3 cups)
1 medium head broccoli (12 ounces), cut into bite-size pieces (about 4 cups)
1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil plus 2 teaspoons, divided
4 tablespoons unsalted butter, at room temperature
3 tablespoons chopped fresh tender herbs (such as tarragon, chives and/or flat-leaf parsley), plus more for garnish
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss quartered beets, broccoli pieces, 1 tablespoon oil, ½ teaspoon pepper and ¼ teaspoon salt on a large rimmed baking sheet; spread in an even layer. Place peeled garlic cloves on a small piece of foil; drizzle with the remaining 2 teaspoons oil, wrap tightly and place in the center of the vegetable mixture. Roast until the broccoli is tender, about 15 minutes.

Combine 4 tablespoons butter, 3 tablespoons herbs and ¼ teaspoon salt in a medium bowl. Carefully unwrap the garlic and transfer it to the bowl. Mash with a fork until well combined. Toss the vegetable mixture with about 2 tablespoons of the garlic-herb butter and spread it back out in an even layer.

Nestle 4 salmon fillets among the vegetables. Season with the remaining ½ teaspoon pepper and ¼ teaspoon salt. Brush with the remaining garlic-herb butter. Roast until the salmon flakes easily with a fork, 8 to 10 minutes. Garnish with additional herbs, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/lemon-turmeri.Title: Lemon-Turmeric Cabbage & White Bean Soup
https://www.eatingwell.com/lemon-turmeri.Description: This cozy soup turns humble ingredients into a bowl of golden comfort. Tender cabbage and cannellini beans simmer with aromatic spices for depth.
Instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add 1 cup onion and the sliced carrot; cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. Add minced garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute. Add 4 cups cabbage, 1 teaspoon each turmeric, paprika, dill and salt and ¼ teaspoon pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. Add 4 cups broth and the rinsed beans; increase heat to high and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to maintain a lively simmer and cook, partially covered, until the vegetables are tender, 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 2 tablespoons lemon juice.

https://www.eatingwell.com/baked-feta-to.Title: Baked Feta, Tomato & White Bean Skillet
https://www.eatingwell.com/baked-feta-to.Description: This Baked Feta, Tomato & White Bean Skillet is the perfect dish for scooping up with your favorite toasted whole-grain bread.
Ingredients: 4 medium cloves garlic, finely chopped (about 4 teaspoons)
6 ounces feta cheese packed in brine, cut into 4 pieces
Instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Combine 2 pints tomatoes, the rinsed beans and chopped garlic, 2 teaspoons Italian seasoning and ¼ teaspoon salt in a large ovenproof enameled skillet. Drizzle with 5 tablespoons oil; stir gently to coat. Nestle feta pieces about 2 inches apart in the mixture. Drizzle the feta with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Bake until the tomatoes have burst and are slightly charred, 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from the oven and drizzle with 1 tablespoon hot honey. Serve with toast. Garnish with basil leaves, if desired. Recipe developed by Marianne Williams

https://www.eatingwell.com/lemony-salmon.Title: Lemony Salmon Rice Bowl with Feta, Cucumber & Tomato Salad
https://www.eatingwell.com/lemony-salmon.Description: This lemony salmon rice bowl is a fresh and satisfying meal that’s quick and flavorful. Flaky broiled salmon is drizzled with a zesty lemon dressing.
Ingredients: 3 tablespoons lemon juice, plus wedges for serving
1 (8.8-ounce) package precooked brown rice, heated according to package instructions
Instructions: Preheat oven to broil with rack in upper third position. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil.

Combine ¼ cup oil, 1 teaspoon lemon zest, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 2 tablespoons chives, 1 tablespoon oregano, 1 teaspoon honey, 1 teaspoon garlic powder, ½ teaspoon onion powder, ½ teaspoon pepper and ¼ teaspoon salt; whisk well.

Pat dry 4 salmon fillets; arrange on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with the remaining ¼ teaspoon salt. Spoon 3 tablespoons of the dressing over the salmon. Broil until opaque in the center and lightly browned around the edges, 6 to 8 minutes.
Combine sliced cucumbers, halved tomatoes, 1 cup feta and 3 tablespoons of the dressing in a medium bowl; toss until well coated.
Divide heated rice among 4 shallow bowls; top with the salmon and the tomato salad. Spoon any remaining dressing over the salmon. Serve with lemon wedges, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-hal.Title: Roasted Veggies with Halloumi & Chickpeas
https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-hal.Description: This sheet-pan halloumi, chickpea and veggie recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner with easy cleanup. Chickpeas and halloumi add protein to make this dish filling.
Ingredients: 1 (15-ounce) can no-salt-added chickpeas, rinsed and patted dry
6 ounces halloumi cheese, cubed (½-inch; about 1½ cups)
1 small red onion, cut into 8 wedges
1 medium zucchini, cut into 1-inch pieces (about 2 cups)
1 small yellow bell pepper, coarsely chopped (about ½ cup)
¼ teaspoon salt plus ⅛ teaspoon, divided
¾ cup whole-milk plain strained (Greek-style) yogurt
1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh mint, plus more for garnish
1 medium clove garlic, grated (about ½ teaspoon)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F with a rack in lower third position. Stir 6 tablespoons oil, 2 teaspoons coriander, 2 teaspoons oregano, 1½ teaspoons paprika and ½ teaspoon cracked pepper together in a small bowl. Toss dried chickpeas, cubed halloumi and onion wedges with 1½ tablespoons of the oil mixture on a large rimmed baking sheet until evenly coated; spread in an even layer. Roast until the cheese is browned and the chickpeas are starting to crisp, about 12 minutes. Stir and spread into an even layer.

Combine zucchini pieces, 2 cups tomatoes, chopped bell pepper, and 1½ tablespoons oil mixture in a medium bowl; toss to coat. Spoon evenly over the chickpea mixture on the baking sheet. Roast until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with ¼ teaspoon salt.

Meanwhile, stir ¾ cup yogurt, 1 tablespoon mint, the grated garlic, 1½ tablespoons oil mixture and the remaining ⅛ teaspoon salt together in a small bowl. Spread the yogurt mixture evenly over 4 plates, then top with the chickpea mixture. Drizzle with the remaining 1½ tablespoons oil mixture. Garnish with additional mint, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/281045.Title: Chicken Hummus Bowls
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/281045.Description: The spiced chicken atop these bowls is ready fast with the help of the broiler. Serve with warm whole-wheat pita for scooping up extra hummus at the bottom of the bowl.
Ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 Aleppo pepper, plus more for serving
Instructions: Position rack in upper third of oven; preheat broiler to high. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.
Toss chicken with 1 tablespoon oil, 1 teaspoon cumin, 1 teaspoon paprika, ¼ teaspoon cayenne and ⅛ teaspoon salt. Spread evenly on the prepared pan. Broil until just cooked through, 5 to 7 minutes.

Meanwhile, mash garlic and the remaining ⅛ teaspoon salt into a paste with a fork. Transfer to a medium bowl and whisk in 2 tablespoons lemon juice and the remaining 2 tablespoons oil. Add the chicken and let stand for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Divide hummus among 4 shallow bowls or plates. Top with the chicken and any remaining dressing, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and ¼ cup parsley.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280316.Title: Garlic Butter–Roasted Salmon with Potatoes & Asparagus
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280316.Description: This one-pan salmon and potatoes recipe makes a healthy and satisfying weeknight dinner. Find out how to make this easy and delicious sheet-pan meal.
Ingredients: 1 pound baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved
1.25 pounds salmon fillet, skinned and cut into 4 portions
Instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss 1 pound of potatoes, 1 tablespoon oil, ¼ teaspoon salt and ⅛ teaspoon pepper together in a medium bowl. Spread in an even layer on a large rimmed baking sheet. Roast until starting to soften and brown, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, toss 12 ounces of asparagus with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil, ⅛ teaspoon salt and ⅛ teaspoon pepper in the medium bowl. Combine 2 tablespoons butter, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, garlic, ¼ teaspoon salt and the remaining ¼ teaspoon pepper in a small bowl.

Sprinkle 1¼ pound salmon with the remaining ⅛ teaspoon salt. Move the potatoes to one side of the pan. Place the salmon in the center of the pan; drizzle with the butter mixture. Spread the asparagus on the empty side of the pan. Roast until the salmon is just cooked through and the vegetables are tender, 10 to 12 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/264141.Title: Baked Eggs in Tomato Sauce with Kale
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/264141.Description: You can make these three-ingredient tomato-simmered eggs with things you probably already have on hand in your fridge and pantry. To make these baked eggs more like eggs in purgatory, look for a spicy tomato sauce and don't forget some whole-wheat bread for dipping.
Ingredients: 3 10-ounce packages frozen chopped kale, thawed, drained and squeezed dry (9 cups)
1 25-ounce jar low-sodium marinara sauce or 3 cups canned low-sodium tomato sauce
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

Heat oil in a 10-inch cast-iron skillet or nonstick ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Add kale, season with 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper, and sauté for 2 minutes. Stir in marinara (or tomato) sauce and bring to a simmer.
Make 8 wells in the sauce with the back of a spoon and carefully crack an egg into each well. Season the eggs with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.
Transfer the pan to the oven and bake until the egg whites are set and the yolks are still soft, about 20 minutes.

https://www.eatingwell.com/high-protein-.Title: High-Protein Black Bean Breakfast Bowl (No Eggs!)
https://www.eatingwell.com/high-protein-.Description: While eggs offer plenty of protein, you don’t always need them for a satisfying, high-protein breakfast.
Ingredients: 1 15-ounce can no-salt-added black beans, drained and rinsed
Instructions: Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Add bell pepper, onion, cumin, oregano, paprika and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are golden and fragrant, 4 to 5 minutes. Add beans; cook, stirring occasionally, until the beans are hot, 2 to 3 minutes.
Divide the bean mixture among 3 bowls. Top each bowl with some avocado, pico de gallo, yogurt, cheese, jalapeños, cilantro and lime juice. Serve with tortillas.

https://www.eatingwell.com/orange-peach-.Title: Orange-Peach Chia Seed Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/orange-peach-.Description: This smoothie is a bright way to start your day. Sweet oranges and frozen peaches are blended with Greek-style yogurt and sweetened naturally by Medjool dates.
Ingredients: ½ cup whole-milk plain strained (Greek-style) yogurt
¼ cup chopped pitted Medjool dates (about 3 dates)
Instructions: Combine 1 cup orange juice, ½ cup yogurt, 2 cups orange segments, 1 cup peaches, ¼ cup chopped dates, 2 tablespoons chia seeds, ½ teaspoon vanilla and ⅛ teaspoon salt in a blender. Blend on high speed until smooth, about 1 minute. Divide between 2 glasses.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/281188.Title: Breakfast Salad with Egg & Salsa Verde Vinaigrette
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/281188.Description: Salad for breakfast? Don't knock it until you've tried it. We love how this meal gives you 3 whole cups of vegetables to start your day.
Ingredients: 3 tablespoons salsa verde, such as Frontera brand
1 tablespoon plus 1 tsp. extra-virgin olive oil, divided
2 tablespoons chopped cilantro, plus more for garnish
2 cups mesclun or other salad greens
8 blue corn tortilla chips, broken into large pieces
0.5 cup canned red kidney beans, rinsed
Instructions: Whisk salsa, 1 Tbsp. oil, and cilantro in a small bowl. Toss half the mixture with mesclun (or other greens) in a shallow dinner bowl.
Layer chips, beans, and avocado atop the salad.
Heat the remaining 1 tsp. oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add egg and fry until the white is completely cooked but the yolk is still slightly runny, about 2 minutes.
Serve the egg on the salad. Drizzle with the remaining salsa vinaigrette and sprinkle with additional cilantro, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280185.Title: Breakfast Beans with Microwave-Poached Egg
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280185.Description: In Costa Rica, this popular breakfast bean dish is called gallo pinto, which means spotted rooster, referring to the dark beans amid the pale rice. We call for cooked barley here, but you can use whatever leftover cooked grain you may have on hand.
Ingredients: 2 chopped scallions, whites and greens separated
0.75 cup rinsed canned low-sodium black beans
0.5 cup low-sodium chicken broth or vegetable broth
Instructions: Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Add bell pepper, scallion whites, and cumin; cook, stirring often, until softened, 1 to 2 minutes. Add beans, cooked barley, broth, and salt. Cook until most of the liquid is absorbed, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in scallion greens and hot sauce. Divide between 2 bowls.

Place 1/2 cup water and 1/2 tsp. vinegar in a microwave-safe small bowl. Carefully crack 1 egg into the water so it is completely submerged. Cover with a microwave-safe plate and microwave on High until the egg white is firm and the yolk is still somewhat runny, about 1 minute. (If necessary, continue to microwave, checking every 10 seconds.) Remove the egg with a slotted spoon, pat dry and place atop the bean mixture in 1 bowl. Repeat with the remaining 1/2 cup water, 1/2 tsp. vinegar, and egg.
Top each bowl with 1 Tbsp. cheese and 1/4 avocado. Sprinkle with cilantro, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/strawberry-ma.Title: Strawberry-Mango Chia Seed Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/strawberry-ma.Description: This strawberry-mango chia seed smoothie is a nutrient-packed drink rich in fiber, antioxidants and omega-3 fatty acids.
Ingredients: 1½ cups quartered fresh strawberries, plus more for garnish
½ cup whole-milk plain strained (Greek-style) yogurt
⅓ cup pitted dried dates (2 ounces), coarsely chopped
Instructions: Combine 2 cups mango, 1½ cups strawberries, ¾ cup ice, 1 cup almond milk, ½ cup yogurt, the chopped dates and 1½ tablespoons chia seeds in a blender; process until smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed, about 30 seconds. Divide between 2 large glasses. Garnish with strawberries, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/270513.Title: Avocado Toast with Burrata
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/270513.Description: Burrata (cream-filled fresh mozzarella cheese) takes this avocado toast recipe to the next level for a decadent, yet weekday-friendly breakfast.
Ingredients: 1.5 ounces burrata or fresh mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Top toast with avocado. Drizzle with lemon juice and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with burrata (or mozzarella), basil, chives and Aleppo pepper.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/265712.Title: Muesli with Raspberries
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/265712.Description: Muesli is a mixture of rolled oats, nuts, seeds and dried fruit. Check out our simple recipe featuring store-bought muesli.
Instructions: Top muesli with raspberries and serve with milk.

https://www.eatingwell.com/mango-blueber.Title: Mango-Blueberry Chia Seed Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/mango-blueber.Description: This chia seed smoothie is a nutrient-packed blend perfect for breakfast. Sweet, tropical mango pairs with juicy blueberries for a balance of flavors.
Ingredients: ½ cup whole-milk plain strained (Greek-style) yogurt
⅓ cup chopped pitted Medjool dates (5 medium dates)
Instructions: Combine 2 cups almond milk, ½ cup yogurt, ½ cup mango nectar, ⅓ cup chopped dates, 2 cups mango chunks, ¾ cup blueberries, 2 tablespoons chia seeds, 2 teaspoons vanilla and ⅛ teaspoon salt in a blender; process until smooth, about 1 minute. Divide between 2 large glasses. Recipe developed by Marianne Williams

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/261611.Title: White Bean & Avocado Toast
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/261611.Description: Mashed avocado and white beans make for a fiber-rich and creamy topping, the perfect partner for a crispy slice of toast. Try it for a quick breakfast or snack.
Ingredients: 0.5 cup canned white beans, rinsed and drained
Instructions: Top toast with mashed avocado and white beans. Season with a pinch each of salt, pepper and crushed red pepper.

https://www.eatingwell.com/berry-green-t.Title: Berry–Green Tea Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/berry-green-t.Description: This berry-green tea smoothie recipe is a refreshing, nutrient-packed beverage with plenty of anti-inflammatory benefits.
Ingredients: 1 cup chilled unsweetened, strong brewed green tea
¼ cup whole-milk plain strained (Greek-style) yogurt
Instructions: Combine 2 cups frozen berries, 1 cup tea, ¼ cup yogurt, 3 dates and 1½ tablespoons chia seeds in a blender; process until smooth, about 1 minute. Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/257117.Title: Avocado Toast with Sprouts
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/257117.Description: Hummus, sprouts and avocado top sprouted whole-wheat bread in this healthy vegan lunch idea. Look for sprouted bread in the freezer section of your grocery store.
Instructions: Toss greens with vinegar, oil, salt and pepper in a medium bowl. Spread each slice of toast with 2 tablespoons hummus. Top with sprouts, avocado and the greens and sprinkle with sunflower seeds.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/263583.Title: Southwest Breakfast Quesadilla
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/263583.Description: Pico de gallo and cheesy eggs make this quick breakfast flavorful and satisfying.
Ingredients: 0.25 cup refrigerated or frozen egg product, thawed
1/8 to 1/4 teaspoon salt-free southwest chipotle seasoning blend
2 tablespoons canned no-salt-added black beans, rinsed and drained
2 tablespoons refrigerated fresh pico de gallo or chopped tomato plus more for garnish
Instructions: Coat a medium nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Preheat skillet over medium heat. Add egg to hot skillet; sprinkle with seasoning blend. Cook over medium heat, without stirring, until egg begins to set on the bottom and around edge. Using a spatula or a large spoon, lift and fold the partially cooked egg so that the uncooked portion flows underneath. Continue cooking over medium heat for 30 to 60 seconds or until egg is cooked through but is still glossy and moist.
Immediately spoon cooked egg onto one side of the tortilla. Top with cheese, beans and the 2 tablespoons pico de gallo. Fold tortilla over filling to cover; press gently.

Wipe out the same skillet with a paper towel. Coat skillet with cooking spray. Preheat skillet over medium heat. Cook filled tortilla in hot skillet about 2 minutes or until tortilla is browned and filling is heated through, turning once. If desired, top with additional pico de gallo.

https://www.eatingwell.com/anti-inflamma.Title: Anti-Inflammatory Raspberry & Spinach Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/anti-inflamma.Description: Start your day off right with this tasty smoothie and boost your daily dose of anti-inflammatory foods while you’re at it!
Ingredients: 2 cups frozen raspberries, plus more for garnish
Instructions: Combine raspberries, spinach, coconut milk, ice, dates and vanilla in a blender; process until smooth, about 2 minutes. Pour into a large glass; garnish with raspberries, if desired. Additional reporting by Carrie Myers, M.S. and Linda Frahm

https://www.eatingwell.com/maple-miso-ch.Title: Maple-Miso Chicken Thighs, Brussels Sprouts & Spaghetti Squash
https://www.eatingwell.com/maple-miso-ch.Description: Roasted spaghetti squash gets tossed with a maple-miso glaze that’s topped with juicy chicken thighs and caramelized Brussels sprouts.
Ingredients: 2 small spaghetti squash (about 2½ pounds each), halved lengthwise and seeded
2 medium garlic cloves, grated (about ¾ teaspoon)
¼ teaspoon salt plus ⅛ teaspoon, divided
4 boneless, skinless chicken thighs (about 1½ pounds total), trimmed
1 pound Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved (about 4 cups)
1 medium scallion, thinly sliced (about ¼ cup)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F with racks in upper and lower third positions. Arrange squash halves, cut-side down, on a large baking sheet. Roast on the upper rack until starting to soften, about 25 minutes.

Meanwhile, whisk 3 tablespoons oil, 2½ tablespoons maple syrup, 2 tablespoons miso, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, the grated garlic and grated ginger, ½ teaspoon soy sauce and ¼ teaspoon salt in a large bowl. Transfer 2 tablespoons of the mixture to another large bowl and set aside. Add trimmed chicken thighs and halved Brussels sprouts to the remaining glaze and toss to coat. Arrange the chicken, skinned-side up, on another large rimmed baking sheet and spread the Brussels sprouts, cut-side down, around the chicken.

Without removing the squash from the oven, place the sheet with chicken and Brussels sprouts on the lower third rack. Roast until the squash is tender, the chicken is browned, and an instant-read thermometer inserted in the thickest part of the chicken registers 165°F, about 15 minutes.

Remove the squash from the oven and let cool slightly. Move the chicken and Brussels sprouts to the upper rack and increase the oven temperature to broil. Broil until browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the remaining ⅛ teaspoon salt.

Using a fork, scrape the squash flesh into strands (discard skins) and transfer to the bowl with the reserved glaze; toss to coat. Divide the squash, chicken and Brussels sprouts among 4 plates. Top with sliced scallion and 1 teaspoon sesame seeds.

https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-sal.Title: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Broccoli
https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-sal.Description: Fresh, fast and full of flavor, this sheet-pan salmon with broccoli is a healthy weeknight winner. A mix of lemon and garlic bring brightness to the dish.
Ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds center-cut salmon filet, skin removed and cut into 4 portions
Chopped parsley and/or chives for garnish (optional)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil; coat with cooking spray.
Whisk 2 tablespoons oil, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, the grated garlic, ½ teaspoon salt and ⅛ teaspoon pepper in a large bowl. Remove 2 tablespoons of the mixture to a small bowl.

Add broccoli florets to the large bowl; toss to coat with the lemon mixture. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet; roast for 5 minutes. Move the broccoli to one side and place the 4 salmon portions on the other side. Spoon the reserved lemon mixture onto the salmon. Roast until the broccoli is tender and the salmon is just cooked through, 7 to 9 minutes. Garnish with parsley and/or chives, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-lem.Title: Sheet-Pan Lemon-Garlic Cod with Roasted Vegetables
https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-lem.Description: This sheet-pan cod and vegetables recipe is a simple, flavorful meal where everything cooks together on one pan for easy cleanup.
Ingredients: 1 pound baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved lengthwise (about 3 cups)
1 medium zucchini, cut into ½ inch-thick half-moons (1½ cups)
1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F with racks in top third and bottom third positions.
Toss halved potatoes, 2 teaspoons oil and ½ teaspoon salt together on a large rimmed baking sheet. Roast on the bottom rack until light golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, toss 1½ cups tomatoes, the sliced zucchini, ¼ teaspoon salt, ¼ teaspoon pepper and the remaining 1 teaspoon oil together in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, combine softened butter, 1 tablespoon parsley, the minced garlic, 1 teaspoon mustard and 1 teaspoon lemon zest.

Place 4 cod fillets on a large sheet of foil. Season the fish with the remaining ½ teaspoon pepper and ¼ teaspoon salt; spread butter mixture over the top of each fillet. Fold up the sides of the foil so liquid will not run out, but do not cover the fish.
Add the tomato mixture to the pan with the browned potatoes. Push the vegetables to the outer edges of the pan to create space for the fish packet. Place the packet in the center of the pan.
Roast on the top rack until the potatoes are golden brown, the tomatoes begin to burst, and the cod is flaky in the center, 10 to 15 minutes. Recipe developed by Jasmine Smith

https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-chi.Title: Sheet-Pan Chickpeas & Spring Veggies
https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-chi.Description: This sheet-pan dinner is a fresh way to celebrate the season. Chickpeas roast alongside tender vegetables on one baking sheet, making cleanup a breeze.
Ingredients: 2 (15-ounce) cans no-salt added chickpeas, rinsed and patted dry
1 pound baby carrots, halved on the bias
1 pound asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces
Instructions: Place a large rimmed baking sheet on middle oven rack; preheat oven to 425°F.

Combine dried rinsed chickpeas, halved carrots, 1 tablespoon oil, ½ teaspoon salt and ⅛ teaspoon pepper in a large bowl; toss to coat. Spread in an even layer on the hot baking sheet. Roast for 10 minutes.

Toss asparagus pieces with 1 tablespoon oil and ¼ teaspoon salt in the large bowl. Add the asparagus to the baking sheet and stir; continue roasting until the carrots are just tender, 10 to 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk 1⅓ cups yogurt, 1 tablespoon lemon zest, 2 tablespoons lemon juice and the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and ¼ teaspoon salt in a small bowl.
Spread the yogurt sauce on a serving platter. Top with the roasted vegetables.

https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-chi.Title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs with Red Cabbage & Sweet Potatoes
https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-chi.Description: These chicken thighs with sweet potatoes and cabbage are a delicious and easy meal to prepare and cleanup is a breeze since everything is cooked on one sheet pan.
Ingredients: 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill, plus more for garnish
1 small head red cabbage ((2 pounds), outer leaves removed
Instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F with rack in lower third position. Whisk ¼ cup each oil and lemon juice, 1 tablespoon dill, the grated garlic, 1½ teaspoons mustard and ¼ teaspoon pepper in a medium bowl until combined. Set aside ¼ cup of the mixture in a small bowl. Add 4 chicken thighs to the medium bowl with the oil-lemon mixture and turn to coat; let stand for 15 minutes while the oven preheats.

While the chicken marinates, cut cabbage into 8 wedges, keeping the core intact. Place the cabbage wedges and 3 cups sweet potatoes on a large rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with the remaining 2 tablespoons oil; toss to coat. Arrange the cabbage wedges, cut-side down, and the sweet potatoes in an even layer. Place the chicken, skin-side up, in the corners of the baking sheet, resting on top of the sweet potatoes if necessary; sprinkle with ¼ teaspoon salt.

Roast until the cabbage is tender and browned in spots and an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest portion of chicken registers at least 165°F, about 40 minutes, flipping cabbage halfway through. Sprinkle ¼ teaspoon salt over the cabbage and sweet potatoes; toss to coat.

Meanwhile, stir yogurt and the remaining 2 tablespoons dill and ¼ teaspoon salt into the reserved oil-lemon mixture (if necessary, stir in water, 1 teaspoon at a time, to reach a thick drizzling consistency). Divide the chicken and vegetables among 4 plates; drizzle with the yogurt mixture. Garnish with additional dill, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-hon.Title: Sheet-Pan Honey Mustard Salmon & Vegetables
https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-hon.Description: This sheet-pan honey mustard salmon & vegetables is a fuss-free meal that's healthy, flavorful and easy to prepare.
Ingredients: 1 pound Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
2 small red onions, cut into 1-inch wedges with root end intact
Chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley for garnish (optional)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place a large rimmed baking sheet in the oven; preheat for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, toss halved Brussels sprouts, onion wedges, 2 tablespoons oil, 1 teaspoon paprika and ½ teaspoon salt together in a medium bowl until the vegetables are well coated.
Carefully remove the hot baking sheet from the oven. Spread the vegetables on the pan in an even layer. Roast until almost tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk 3 tablespoons honey mustard, 1 tablespoon vinegar, 2 teaspoons garlic, ½ teaspoon crushed red pepper and the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and ¼ teaspoon salt together in the bowl.

Push the vegetables to one side of the pan. Arrange salmon fillets in the empty space. Brush the salmon with the mustard mixture. Roast until the salmon is just cooked through and the vegetables are tender, 7 to 10 minutes. Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-bal.Title: Sheet-Pan Balsamic Chicken & Asparagus
https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-bal.Description: Chicken cutlets are coated in a tangy-sweet balsamic glaze, roasting right alongside tender asparagus for an easy, well-balanced dinner.
Ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, plus more for garnish
Instructions: Position oven rack in upper third; preheat oven to 375°F. Place 4 chicken cutlets on one side of a large rimmed baking sheet. Brush both sides with 1 tablespoon oil; sprinkle with 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, ½ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon pepper. Bake for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, stir 2 tablespoons vinegar, ½ teaspoon garlic powder and the remaining 1 tablespoon oil together in a small bowl.

Remove the chicken from the oven. Preheat broiler to high. Place trimmed asparagus, ¾ cup red onion and 1 tablespoon capers on the empty side of the pan; drizzle with half the vinegar mixture and toss to coat. Flip the chicken pieces and drizzle with the remaining mixture.
Broil until the asparagus is tender-crisp and an instant-read thermometer inserted in the thickest part of the chicken registers 165°F, about 10 minutes. Drizzle with more vinegar, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-sal.Title: Sheet-Pan Salmon & Shaved Brussels Sprouts
https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-sal.Description: This sheet-pan salmon and Brussels sprouts recipe is a game-changer for weeknight dinners.
Ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves or ½ teaspoon dried thyme
1 pound Brussels sprouts, trimmed and thinly shaved (about 6 cups)
½ teaspoon salt plus ⅛ teaspoon, divided
Instructions: Preheat broiler with rack in middle position. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil. Zest 2 lemons to yield 2 teaspoons zest and juice the lemons to yield ¼ cup juice. Mince 4 garlic cloves to yield 1½ tablespoons and smash the remaining 2 garlic cloves.

Combine 2 teaspoons oregano, 1 teaspoon paprika, 1 teaspoon fresh thyme (or ½ teaspoon dried), 1 teaspoon black pepper, ¼ teaspoon crushed red pepper (if using), the lemon zest, 3 tablespoons lemon juice and the minced garlic in a small bowl. Add 1 tablespoon oil; whisk to combine.

Combine sliced Brussels sprouts, sliced shallot and the smashed garlic with 1 tablespoon oil on the prepared baking sheet; spread in an even layer. Nestle 4 salmon fillets, skin-side down, among the vegetables. Drizzle the salmon and vegetables with the lemon mixture.
Broil until the Brussels sprouts are tender and the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with ½ teaspoon salt.

Place the roasted garlic cloves on a cutting board and mash into a paste using the flat side of a large knife; transfer to a small bowl. Whisk in the remaining 2 tablespoons oil, 1 tablespoon lemon juice and ⅛ teaspoon salt. Drizzle the lemon mixture evenly over the salmon and Brussels sprouts; toss the Brussels sprouts.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/262739.Title: Sheet-Pan Shrimp & Beets
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/262739.Description: For this easy sheet-pan dinner, beets get a head start in the oven while you prep the shrimp and kale. For a prettier presentation, leave the shrimp tails intact. Serve this one-pan recipe with a cool glass of rosé.
Ingredients: 1 pound small beets, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces
1.25 pounds extra-large raw shrimp (16-20 count), peeled and deveined
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.
Toss beets with 1 tablespoon oil and 1/4 teaspoon each salt and pepper in a large bowl. Spread evenly on a rimmed baking sheet. Roast for 15 minutes.
Toss kale with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and 1/4 teaspoon each salt and pepper in the bowl. Stir into the beets on the baking sheet.

Sprinkle shrimp with mustard, tarragon and the remaining 1/4 teaspoon each salt and pepper. Place on top of the vegetables. Roast until the shrimp are cooked and the vegetables are tender, 10 to 15 minutes more.
Transfer the shrimp to a serving platter. Stir sunflower seeds into the vegetables and serve with the shrimp.

https://www.eatingwell.com/lemon-garlic-.Title: Lemon-Garlic Sheet-Pan Salmon with Potatoes & Green Beans
https://www.eatingwell.com/lemon-garlic-.Description: This sheet-pan salmon with green beans recipe is a game-changer for weeknight dinners, offering a balanced meal made entirely on one sheet pan.
Ingredients: 1 (24-ounce) package baby Yukon Gold potatoes, scrubbed and halved or quartered (about 5 cups)
4 small cloves garlic, finely chopped (about 1 tablespoon)
1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill, plus more for garnish
1 (8-ounce) package trimmed haricots verts or thin green beans (about 4 cups)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Toss potatoes, 1 tablespoon oil, ½ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon pepper together on the prepared baking sheet until coated; spread into an even layer. Roast until the potatoes begin to soften and brown, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk 2 tablespoons lemon juice, the chopped garlic, 1 tablespoon dill and the remaining 2 tablespoons oil and ½ teaspoon each salt and pepper together in a small bowl.

Push the potatoes to one side of the pan. Arrange 4 salmon fillets and 4 cups haricots verts (or thin green beans) in an even layer in the empty space. Brush half of the lemon juice mixture (about 2 tablespoons) over the salmon; drizzle the remaining mixture over the beans. Roast until the potatoes are fork-tender, the beans are tender-crisp and the salmon flakes easily with a fork, about 15 minutes. Garnish with additional dill, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-sal.Title: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Melting Leeks
https://www.eatingwell.com/sheet-pan-sal.Description: This panko-crusted salmon roasts alongside tender leeks, which offer a boost of prebiotics to support a healthy gut.
Ingredients: 6 leeks, white and light green parts only, well rinsed and patted dry
2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil plus 2½ teaspoons, divided
2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon, divided, plus more for garnish
3 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, divided
¾ cup whole-milk plain strained (Greek-style) yogurt
½ cup garlic-and-herb spreadable cheese (such as Boursin or Alouette), at room temperature
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Trim leeks, removing and discarding dark green parts. Remove and discard outer layer of each leek; cut into 1-inch coins.

Toss the leeks with 1 tablespoon oil, 2 teaspoons thyme and ½ teaspoon pepper on a large rimmed baking sheet until well coated. Spread into an even layer around the edges of the pan. Roast until mostly tender and starting to brown, about 10 minutes. Drizzle with ½ cup broth and 1 tablespoon lemon juice; roast until the liquid has been fully absorbed, about 12 minutes.

Meanwhile, stir 2 tablespoons mustard and 1 tablespoon tarragon together in a small bowl; spread evenly over 4 salmon fillets (about 1½ tablespoons each). Combine ½ cup panko, 1 tablespoon each parsley and oil, 1 teaspoon lemon zest and the remaining 2 teaspoons thyme in a medium bowl. Sprinkle evenly over the salmon, pressing gently to adhere.

Carefully flip the leeks. Drizzle the center of the baking sheet with 1½ teaspoons oil and place the salmon there. Roast until the leeks are well browned and the salmon is just cooked through, about 12 minutes. Sprinkle the leeks and salmon with ⅛ teaspoon salt.

Meanwhile, prepare lentils according to package directions. Combine ¾ cup yogurt, ½ cup spreadable cheese, the grated garlic and the remaining 1 tablespoon tarragon, 2 tablespoons parsley, 1 teaspoon lemon zest and ½ teaspoon pepper in a bowl. Add the remaining 1 teaspoon oil and ⅛ teaspoon salt to the lentils; toss to coat. Spread the yogurt mixture on 4 plates; top with the lentils, leeks and salmon. Garnish with additional tarragon, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/281181.Title: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Sweet Potatoes & Broccoli
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/281181.Description: This salmon and sweet potato dinner bursts with flavor from the cheese, cilantro, chili and lime. Learn how to make this easy sheet-pan meal.
Ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
4 cups broccoli florets (8 oz.; 1 medium crown)
1.25 pounds salmon fillet, cut into 4 portions
2 limes, 1 zested and juiced, 1 cut into wedges for serving
0.25 cup crumbled feta or cotija cheese
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil and coat with cooking spray.
Combine 3 tablespoons mayonnaise and 1 teaspoon chili powder in a small bowl. Set aside.
Toss 2 sweet potatoes with 2 teaspoons oil, ¼ teaspoon salt and ⅛ teaspoon pepper in a medium bowl. Spread on the prepared baking sheet. Roast for 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, toss 4 cups broccoli with the remaining 2 teaspoons oil, ¼ teaspoon salt and ⅛ teaspoon pepper in the same bowl. Remove the baking sheet from oven. Stir the sweet potatoes and move them to the sides of the pan. Arrange 1¼ pounds salmon in the center of the pan and spread the broccoli on either side, among the sweet potatoes. Spread 2 tablespoons of the mayonnaise mixture over the salmon. Bake until the sweet potatoes are tender and the salmon flakes easily with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, add lime zest and lime juice from 1 lime to the remaining 1 tablespoon mayonnaise; mix well.

Divide the salmon among 4 plates and top with ¼ cup cheese and ½ cup cilantro. Divide the sweet potatoes and broccoli among the plates and drizzle with the lime-mayonnaise sauce. Serve with lime wedges and any remaining sauce.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/274851.Title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajita Bowls
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/274851.Description: This recipe can fit into your weekly dinner plans if you follow a Mediterranean diet meal plan or a Dash Diet meal plan. But it's delicious anytime.
Ingredients: 1 (15 ounce) can no-salt-added black beans, rinsed
Instructions: Place a large rimmed baking sheet in the oven; preheat to 425 degrees F.

Combine 2 teaspoons chili powder, 2 teaspoons cumin, 1/2 tsp. salt, ½ teaspoon garlic powder, ½ teaspoon paprika, and ¼ teaspoon ground pepper in a large bowl. Transfer 1 teaspoon of the spice mixture to a medium bowl and set aside. Whisk 1 tablespoon oil into the remaining spice mixture in the large bowl. Add 1 ¼ pounds chicken, 1 medium onion, and 1 red and 1 green bell peppers; toss to coat.
Remove the pan from the oven; coat with cooking spray. Spread the chicken mixture in an even layer on the pan. Roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine 4 cups kale and 1 can black beans with the remaining 1/4 tsp. salt and 1 Tbsp. olive oil in a large bowl; toss to coat.
Remove the pan from the oven. Stir the chicken and vegetables. Spread kale and beans evenly over the top. Roast until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender, 5 to 7 minutes more.
Meanwhile, add ¼ cup yogurt, 1 tablespoon lime juice, and 2 teaspoons water to the reserved spice mixture; stir to combine.
Divide the chicken and vegetable mixture among 4 bowls. Drizzle with the yogurt dressing and serve.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/263978.Title: Sheet-Pan Orange-Apricot Drumsticks
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/263978.Description: Transform ordinary drumsticks into a satisfying meal perfect for serving guests. The sweet-and-savory glaze and colorful vegetables will be a hit.
Ingredients: 1 pound multicolor fingerling potatoes, halved lengthwise
4 large chicken drumsticks (1 1/2-2 lbs. total), skin removed
1 tablespoon reduced-sodium soy sauce or tamari
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Place 1 pound of potatoes, 1 pound green beans and 1 cup sliced onion on a large rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons oil and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Nestle 4 chicken drumsticks into the vegetables.

Grate 1/2 teaspoon zest from 1 orange and squeeze it to get 2 tablespoons juice. Combine the zest and juice, 3 tablespoons preserves, 1 tablespoon soy sauce (or tamari), 3 cloves garlic and the remaining 1/4 teaspoon each salt and pepper in a small bowl. Brush the chicken with half of the glaze.

Roast the chicken and vegetables for 15 minutes. Stir the vegetables; turn the chicken and brush with the remaining glaze. Continue roasting until the chicken registers at least 165°F on an instant-read thermometer and the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes more.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/252493.Title: Garlic Roasted Salmon & Brussels Sprouts
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/252493.Description: Roasting salmon on top of Brussels sprouts and garlic, flavored with wine and fresh oregano, is simple enough for a weeknight meal yet sophisticated enough to serve to company. Serve with whole-wheat couscous.
Ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh oregano, divided
6 cups Brussels sprouts, trimmed and sliced
2 pounds wild-caught salmon fillet, skinned, cut into 6 portions
Instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F.

Mince 2 garlic cloves and combine in a small bowl with oil, 1 tablespoon oregano, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Halve the remaining garlic and toss with Brussels sprouts and 3 tablespoons of the seasoned oil in a large roasting pan. Roast, stirring once, for 15 minutes.

Add wine to the remaining oil mixture. Remove the pan from oven, stir the vegetables and place salmon on top. Drizzle with the wine mixture. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon oregano and 1/2 teaspoon each salt and pepper. Bake until the salmon is just cooked through, 5 to 10 minutes more. Serve with lemon wedges.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280094.Title: Rosemary Roasted Salmon with Asparagus & Potatoes
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280094.Description: Yukon Golds are great here because they get crispy on the outside but completely creamy on the inside. A brush stroke or two of balsamic glaze provides a rich color and a sweet finish to the roasted salmon.
Ingredients: 1.25 pounds Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces
4 (5 ounce) skinless salmon fillets, preferably wild
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.

Stir together oil, rosemary and garlic in a small bowl. Place potatoes in a large bowl and toss with 1 tablespoon of the oil mixture and 1/2 teaspoon each salt and pepper. Arrange the potatoes in an even layer on a large rimmed baking sheet. Roast until lightly browned and tender, about 20 minutes. Push the potatoes to one end of the pan.

Place asparagus in the large bowl and toss with 1 tablespoon of the oil mixture, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Arrange the asparagus on other end of the baking sheet. Roast until the asparagus is bright green, about 3 minutes. Push the vegetables to either end of the pan, leaving space in the center.

Brush salmon with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil mixture and sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Place the salmon in the center of the pan. Thinly slice half the lemon and tuck the slices around the salmon and vegetables. Roast for 5 minutes more. Cut the remaining lemon half into wedges.

Whisk balsamic glaze and mustard in a small bowl. Brush 1 tablespoon of the mixture on the salmon. Continue roasting until the salmon is just cooked through and the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes. Drizzle the vegetables with the remaining sauce. Serve with the lemon wedges.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/262763.Title: Roasted Salmon with Smoky Chickpeas & Greens
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/262763.Description: In this healthy salmon dinner, you'll get a dose of greens and green dressing! Chowing down on 6 or more servings of dark leafy greens a week can help keep your brain in top shape. This dish features the Test Kitchen's current go-to method for doctoring a can of chickpeas: spice them up and roast until crispy.
Ingredients: 0.5 teaspoon salt, divided, plus a pinch
0.25 cup chopped fresh chives and/or dill, plus more for garnish
1.25 pounds wild salmon, cut into 4 portions
Instructions: Position racks in upper third and middle of oven; preheat to 425 degrees F.

Combine 1 tablespoon oil, paprika and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a medium bowl. Very thoroughly pat chickpeas dry, then toss with the paprika mixture. Spread on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake the chickpeas on the upper rack, stirring twice, for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, puree buttermilk, mayonnaise, herbs, 1/4 teaspoon pepper and garlic powder in a blender until smooth. Set aside.

Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add kale and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. Add water and continue cooking until the kale is tender, about 5 minutes more. Remove from heat and stir in a pinch of salt.

Remove the chickpeas from the oven and push them to one side of the pan. Place salmon on the other side and season with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon each salt and pepper. Bake until the salmon is just cooked through, 5 to 8 minutes.
Drizzle the reserved dressing on the salmon, garnish with more herbs, if desired, and serve with the kale and chickpeas.

https://www.eatingwell.com/feta-cherry-t.Title: Feta & Cherry-Tomato Appetizer Board
https://www.eatingwell.com/feta-cherry-t.Description: This is the easiest no-cook appetizer you’ll be making all summer long featuring feta and cherry tomatoes.
Instructions: Cut feta into 18 (¾-by-1-inch) cubes. Arrange the feta cubes and 18 cherry tomatoes in a checkered pattern to create a 6-inch square on a large plate. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons oil. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon basil, ½ teaspoon lemon zest, ⅛ teaspoon crushed red pepper and salt (if using). Drizzle 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar around the sides of the plate. Serve with toasted baguette, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/high-protein-.Title: High-Protein Caesar Dip
https://www.eatingwell.com/high-protein-.Description: This high-protein dip—reminiscent of Caesar salad dressing—is the perfect companion for your favorite veggies.
Ingredients: ¼ cup lemon juice (from 2 small lemons)
¾ teaspoon ground pepper, plus more for garnish
Lettuce spears, cucumbers, carrots, radishes and/or whole-wheat crackers, for dipping (optional)
Instructions: Whisk 2 cups yogurt, ½ cup sour cream, ¼ cup lemon juice, ¼ cup water, 2 tablespoons Parmesan, 1 tablespoon garlic powder, 2½ teaspoons Worcestershire, 2 teaspoons mustard, ¾ teaspoon pepper and ¾ teaspoon salt together in a medium bowl until smooth and well combined. Garnish with additional pepper, if desired. Serve with desired dippers.

https://www.eatingwell.com/white-bean-st.Title: White Bean–Stuffed Mini Bell Peppers
https://www.eatingwell.com/white-bean-st.Description: Mini bell peppers are the perfect vessel for delivering creamy bean dip with a crunchy chickpea topping in this easy snack.
Ingredients: ½ cup white bean dip or hummus

https://www.eatingwell.com/tzatziki-cucu.Title: Tzatziki Cucumber Slices
https://www.eatingwell.com/tzatziki-cucu.Description: Tzatziki cucumber slices offer a refreshing, quick snack with just three ingredients.
Ingredients: ¼ cup lightly salted dry-roasted shelled pistachios, roughly chopped
Instructions: Slice 1 cucumber on the bias into 12 (¼-inch-thick) pieces. Top each slice with tzatziki (about 1 teaspoon each). Sprinkle evenly with ¼ cup pistachios.

https://www.eatingwell.com/high-protein-.Title: High-Protein Dip Formula
https://www.eatingwell.com/high-protein-.Description: These high-protein cottage cheese dips are easy to whip up and pair perfectly with your favorite fruits and veggies.
Ingredients: 3 cups mini bell peppers or sliced bell peppers
Instructions: Combine 2 cups cottage cheese, 3 tablespoons pesto and 2 tablespoons Parmesan in a food processor. Process until smooth, about 5 seconds. Serve with 3 cups peppers.

https://www.eatingwell.com/whipped-feta-.Title: Whipped Feta Honey Toast
https://www.eatingwell.com/whipped-feta-.Description: This whipped feta toast gets a drizzle of honey and a sprinkling of your favorite fresh herbs.
Ingredients: 4 ounces feta cheese in brine, drained and crumbled (about 1 cup)
1 1/2 tablespoons chopped mixed fresh tender herbs (such as chives, dill and flat-leaf parsley)
Instructions: Combine feta, yogurt and 1 tablespoon oil in a food processor; process until smooth and creamy, 4 to 5 minutes, stopping to scrape down the sides every 30 seconds.
Spread the feta mixture over 1 side of each toast slice; sprinkle with pepper and drizzle with honey. Top with herbs. Garnish with lemon zest, if desired. Drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil.

https://www.eatingwell.com/cucumber-salm.Title: Cucumber Salmon Bites
https://www.eatingwell.com/cucumber-salm.Description: Look no further for your impromptu-gathering appetizer—these 3-ingredient cucumber salmon bites are a surefire hit. Beyond being an ideal choice for entertaining, this quick and easy recipe doubles as a satisfying snack.
Ingredients: 2 ounces smoked salmon, cut into 24 pieces
Fresh cracked black pepper for garnish (optional)
Instructions: Spread each cucumber slice with cream cheese (about 1 teaspoon each). Top each with a piece of smoked salmon. Garnish with cracked black pepper, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/apricot-stilt.Title: Apricot-Stilton Bites
https://www.eatingwell.com/apricot-stilt.Description: Savory blue cheese and sweet-tart dried apricots combine for an impressive last-minute appetizer for any gathering.
Instructions: Place 1 teaspoon cheese on each apricot; top each with 1/2 teaspoon pistachios. Drizzle evenly with agave. Sprinkle evenly with thyme.

https://www.eatingwell.com/whipped-feta-.Title: Whipped Feta with Pomegranate, Pistachios & Honey
https://www.eatingwell.com/whipped-feta-.Description: This easy, quick appetizer is perfect for any gathering. Be sure to process the feta and cream cheese together until you see a smooth texture and ribbons start to form.
Ingredients: 1 (6-oz.) package feta cheese in brine, crumbled (1½ cups)
2 (6½-inch) whole-wheat pita rounds, warmed and cut into 16 wedges
Instructions: Add feta, cream cheese, garlic and oil to a food processor; process until mostly smooth, about 2 minutes, stopping to scrape down sides as needed. With the processor running, slowly drizzle cold water through the chute until a smooth whipped dip forms, 3 to 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving bowl; top with pomegranate seeds and pistachios; drizzle with honey. Sprinkle with thyme leaves. Serve with warm pita wedges.

https://www.eatingwell.com/lemon-mint-wh.Title: Lemon, Mint & White Bean Dip
https://www.eatingwell.com/lemon-mint-wh.Description: This quick, healthy dip is an easy appetizer or snack. If you don't have cannellini beans, chickpeas work just as well.
Ingredients: 1 (15-oz.) can no-salt-added cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
Instructions: Drop garlic through chute with food processor on; process until minced. Add beans, mint, zest, lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper; process until smooth. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Serve with carrots.

https://www.eatingwell.com/cheddar-apple.Title: Cheddar-Apple Cracker Bites
https://www.eatingwell.com/cheddar-apple.Description: This easy recipe comes together in just 5 minutes, making it a quick snack or appetizer. The sweetness of the Fuji balances well with the cheddar, but you can use another variety of apple if you prefer.
Ingredients: 2 (0.7-oz.) slices reduced-fat cheddar cheese, cut into quarters
24 thin vertical Fuji apple slices (1 medium apple)
Instructions: Place 1 cheese quarter on top of each cracker. Top each with 3 apple slices.
Combine honey and mustard in a small bowl. Drizzle evenly over apples. Garnish with rosemary sprigs, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/tomato-zucchi.Title: Tomato-Zucchini Salsa
https://www.eatingwell.com/tomato-zucchi.Description: This easy, veggie-packed dip makes a healthy snack or appetizer. Capers add a nice brininess to this salsa.
Ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped bottled roasted red bell peppers
Instructions: Combine tomato, zucchini, red bell peppers, red onion, basil, parsley, lemon juice, oil, capers, salt, black pepper and garlic together in a bowl. Serve immediately or refrigerate in an airtight container up to 2 days.

https://www.eatingwell.com/cherry-goat-c.Title: Cherry & Goat Cheese Crostini
https://www.eatingwell.com/cherry-goat-c.Description: These savory crostini are an easy, 10-minute appetizer. If using frozen cherries, be sure to pat them dry before assembling.
Ingredients: 12 (1/2-in.-thick) diagonally cut French bread baguette slices, toasted
1 cup halved and quartered pitted fresh cherries
Instructions: Combine goat cheese, orange zest, salt and pepper together in a small bowl. Spread goat cheese mixture evenly on one side of each toast slice. Top evenly with cherries and pistachios. Drizzle evenly with honey.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/792407.Title: Pimiento Cheese-Stuffed Mini Bell Peppers
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/792407.Description: These stuffed mini peppers are packed with pimiento cheese for an easy, three-ingredient appetizer.
Ingredients: 6 mini bell peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded
Instructions: Fill each pepper half with about 1 tablespoon cheese spread. Sprinkle with chives.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/267209.Title: Easy Black Bean Dip
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/267209.Description: This creamy bean dip is great for a party or picnic. Smoked paprika and ground chipotles add a robust, earthy flavor, but you can also use regular paprika and cayenne if you don't have the other spices on hand.
Ingredients: 1 (15 ounce) can low-sodium black beans, rinsed
0.25 teaspoon cayenne pepper or ground chipotle chile
0.25 cup chopped fresh cilantro or scallions
Instructions: Place beans, yogurt, lime juice, cumin, oregano, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper in a food processor or blender. Process until well combined, about 20 seconds. For a spicier dip, add cayenne (or ground chipotle) to taste, up to 1/4 teaspoon. Add oil, cilantro (or scallions) and onion. Pulse until well mixed, about 20 seconds. Transfer to a bowl to serve.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/804116.Title: Light & Airy Whipped Cottage Cheese
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/804116.Description: Give this whipped cottage cheese recipe your own spin by making it with your favorite fresh herbs. You can use it as a dip with fresh veggies or as a sandwich spread.
Ingredients: 0.25 cup finely chopped herbs, such as parsley, basil or dill, plus more for garnish
Instructions: Place cottage cheese in a food processor and process on High, scraping the sides of the bowl down once halfway through, until smooth and creamy, about 1 minute. Add lemon juice, oil, herbs and pepper; pulse until well blended. Garnish with more herbs, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/788142.Title: Apricot, Prosciutto & Parmesan Bites
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/788142.Description: These 3-ingredient apricot, Parmesan and prosciutto bites are as simple to make as they look, and they taste even better. Simply layer each ingredient on top of the other and secure with a toothpick for an easy bite-size starter.
Ingredients: 10 slices prosciutto, cut in half lengthwise
1 (8-ounce) wedge Parmesan cheese, cut into 1-inch slices
Instructions: Roll up 1 piece of prosciutto and place 1 slice Parmesan and 1 apricot on top. Secure with a toothpick. Repeat with the remaining prosciutto, Parmesan and apricots.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/252614.Title: Classic Hummus
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/252614.Description: It's easy to make hummus at home with just a few pantry items. Serve drizzled with your best-quality extra-virgin olive oil and chopped parsley. Mop it up with warm whole-wheat pita bread or cut-up vegetables.
Instructions: With the motor running, drop garlic through the feed tube of a food processor fitted with a steel blade attachment; process until finely minced. Scrape down the sides of the workbowl and add chickpeas, lemon juice, oil, tahini and salt. Process until completely smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides as necessary, 1 to 2 minutes.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/259666.Title: Turmeric-Ginger Tahini Dip
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/259666.Description: Flavored with turmeric, ginger and garlic, this tahini dip recipe is perfect for dipping vegetables or topping your next falafel.
Instructions: Whisk tahini, vinegar, water, ginger, turmeric, garlic and salt in a medium bowl until well combined.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/256572.Title: Avocado Hummus
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/256572.Description: This vibrant green hummus recipe couldn't be easier--just toss a few ingredients in the food processor and whir away! Aquafaba (the liquid from a can of chickpeas) and avocado make this healthy dip extra smooth and creamy. Serve with veggie chips, pita chips or crudités.
Instructions: Drain chickpeas, reserving 2 tablespoons of the liquid. Transfer the chickpeas and the reserved liquid to a food processor. Add avocado, cilantro, tahini, oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt. Puree until very smooth. Serve with veggie chips, pita chips or crudités.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/250924.Title: Avocado-Yogurt Dip
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/250924.Description: Update your guacamole recipe by adding protein-packed yogurt to make a healthy dip recipe. For an extra kick, add minced jalapeño or your favorite hot sauce for some zing! Serve this healthy dip recipe with crunchy vegetables, pita chips or pretzels, or use as a sandwich spread.
Instructions: Place avocado, yogurt, cilantro, onion, lime juice, salt and pepper in a food processor. Process until smooth. Season with hot sauce, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/egg-tomato-fe.Title: Egg, Tomato & Feta Breakfast Pita
https://www.eatingwell.com/egg-tomato-fe.Description: This za’atar pita fried egg is perfect for those looking to enjoy a delicious start to their day!
Instructions: Combine ¼ cup each cucumber and tomato, 1 tablespoon feta and ½ teaspoon za’atar in a small bowl; toss to coat.

Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Break 2 eggs, one at a time, into the skillet. Cover and cook until the whites are set, about 2 minutes. Uncover and cook until the whites are completely set and the edges are crisp, about 2 minutes 30 seconds. Sprinkle the eggs with the remaining ¼ teaspoon za’atar; place each inside a pita half. Divide the cucumber-tomato mixture between the pitas.

https://www.eatingwell.com/blt-breakfast.Title: BLT Breakfast Sandwich
https://www.eatingwell.com/blt-breakfast.Description: This open-face sandwich is a delicious way to start your day. Turkey bacon provides savory flavor and crunch while keeping fat and calories in check.
Ingredients: 1 slice cooked turkey bacon, cut in half
Instructions: Combine 2 teaspoons mayonnaise and the chopped sun-dried tomato in a small bowl. Spread on 1 side of toast slice;  top with 3 lettuce leaves, 2 tomato slices and the bacon pieces. Sprinkle with ⅛ teaspoon pepper.

https://www.eatingwell.com/high-protein-.Title: High-Protein Orange-Mango Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/high-protein-.Description: This high-protein orange-mango smoothie is a bright and refreshing drink that combines the tangy sweetness of fresh orange juice with the tropical richness of mangoes.
Ingredients: 1 cup orange juice, plus orange twists for garnish (from 2 medium oranges)
½ cup nonfat plain strained (Greek-style) yogurt
¼ cup plain, unsweetened, plant-based protein powder
Instructions: Combine 1 cup orange juice, 1 cup frozen mango, 1 cup soy milk, ½ cup yogurt, ¼ cup protein powder and 1 tablespoon maple syrup in a blender; blend until smooth and creamy, about 2 minutes. Divide between 2 glasses. Garnish with orange twists, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/cottage-chees.Title: Cottage Cheese–Berry Bowl
https://www.eatingwell.com/cottage-chees.Description: This no-sugar-added berry bowl highlights the natural sweetness of thawed mixed berries with a hint of vanilla for extra flavor.
Ingredients: 1 cup frozen mixed berries, thawed slightly
¼ cup Grape Nuts or similar cereal
Instructions: Combine 2 cups cottage cheese and ½ teaspoon vanilla in a small bowl. Divide the cottage cheese mixture among 4 bowls. Top each with ¼ cup berries, 1 tablespoon cereal and 1 tablespoon walnuts.

https://www.eatingwell.com/feta-egg-spin.Title: Feta, Egg & Spinach Breakfast Taco
https://www.eatingwell.com/feta-egg-spin.Description: It doesn’t get easier than this healthy breakfast taco that’s ready in just five minutes. Kale or arugula will work just as well if you don’t have spinach on hand.
Ingredients: 1 teaspoon avocado oil or canola oil
Instructions: Heat oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook tortilla, flipping once, until softened, about 1 minute total; transfer to a plate. Add spinach to the pan; cook, stirring, until just barely wilted, about 1 minute. Transfer to the tortilla. Sprinkle feta in an egg-sized circle in the pan, leaving an open spot in the center. Break egg into the feta. Cover and cook until the egg is done to your liking, about 2 minutes for over easy. Transfer to the spinach and drizzle with hot sauce, if desired.

https://www.eatingwell.com/batida-de-lec.Title: Batida de Lechosa (Papaya Smoothie)
https://www.eatingwell.com/batida-de-lec.Description: Papaya is one of the most popular fruits in the Dominican Republic. Learn how a Dominican dietitian uses it for a nutritious smoothie, perfect for dessert, breakfast or a snack.
Ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cubed fresh or frozen papaya
Instructions: Place papaya, milk, ice, vanilla and cinnamon in a blender; process until smooth. Add sugar, if using, and blend until smooth.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/800772.Title: Coconut-Mango Oats
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/800772.Description: This coconut-mango oats recipe can be made with any type of milk, and is ready in just five minutes for an easy, quick breakfast.
Ingredients: 1 tablespoon toasted unsweetened shredded coconut, divided
0.25 cup diced ripe mango, fresh or frozen
Instructions: Bring oat milk to a boil in a small pot over high heat. Reduce heat to medium. Stir in oats and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until most of the liquid is absorbed and the bubbles from the oat milk become smaller, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1 1/2 teaspoons coconut, brown sugar and vanilla; transfer to a serving bowl. Top with mango, the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons coconut and chia seeds.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/271091.Title: Strawberry-Pineapple Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/271091.Description: Make this smoothie for busy mornings with almond milk, strawberries and pineapple, plus almond butter for extra creaminess and filling protein.
Ingredients: 0.75 cup chilled unsweetened almond milk, plus more if needed
Instructions: Combine 1 cup strawberries, 1 cup pineapple, ¾ cup almond milk and 1 tablespoon almond butter in a blender. Process until smooth, adding more almond milk, if needed, for desired consistency. Serve immediately.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/796199.Title: Creamy Strawberry Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/796199.Description: Learn how to make this creamy strawberry smoothie recipe. It's perfect for breakfast or a snack and can be made with any kind of milk you prefer.
Ingredients: 0.75 cup low-fat milk  or  unsweetened nondairy milk
0.25 cup low-fat plain Greek  or  regular yogurt
Instructions: Place strawberries, milk, yogurt, honey (or maple syrup), if using, and vanilla in a blender. Blend until smooth.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/805738.Title: Spinach & Fried Egg Grain Bowls
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/805738.Description: Wheat berries, a nutty-tasting whole grain with a pleasantly chewy texture, are the base of this hearty breakfast bowl recipe.
Ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted roasted peanuts, roughly chopped
Instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add spinach; cook, stirring often, until wilted, about 3 minutes. Stir in soy sauce; transfer the mixture to a bowl.
Crack eggs into the skillet; cook for 2 minutes. Cover and continue to cook until desired degree of doneness, 2 more minutes for medium.
Divide wheat berries among 4 bowls; top each serving with an egg, 1/4 cup spinach mixture and 1 tablespoon kimchi. Top evenly with scallions and peanuts.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/268783.Title: Two-Ingredient Banana Pancakes
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/268783.Description: These 2-ingredient banana pancakes are best enjoyed right after cooking. Serve with maple syrup and yogurt or ricotta cheese to add in some protein.
Instructions: Puree eggs and banana in a blender until smooth.

Lightly oil a large nonstick skillet (see Tip) and heat over medium heat. Using 2 tablespoons of batter for each pancake, drop 4 mounds of batter into the pan. Cook until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges look dry, 2 to 4 minutes. Using a thin spatula, gently flip the pancakes and cook until browned on the bottom, 1 to 2 minutes more. Transfer the pancakes to a plate. Lightly oil the pan again and repeat with the remaining batter. Additional reporting by Carrie Myers, M.S. and Jan Valdez

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/795946.Title: Mixed-Berry Breakfast Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/795946.Description: This mixed-berry smoothie is packed with protein, carbohydrates and fat, and will keep you satisfied until your next meal.
Instructions: Combine berries, water, yogurt, banana, avocado and walnuts in a blender. Blend on high speed until smooth. If necessary, add more water to reach desired consistency.

https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280741.Title: Cherry Smoothie
https://www.eatingwell.com/recipe/280741.Description: The combination of oat milk, vanilla extract and sweet cherries makes this recipe taste like a cherry pie smoothie. Adding a bit of brown sugar boosts that nostalgia even more.
